text: You want to return the water bottle, and exchange the pet bed and office chair to the cheapest version. Mention the two things together and you want to get both done. If and only if you can only do one of the two things, you prefer to do whatever saves you most money. Ask the agent how much money you can save in both options.
zh: 您想退货水壶，并换宠物床和办公椅到最便宜版本。请将这两件事一起提，您希望一次性办完。如果只能做其中一件，您希望选择最省钱的那一个。请询问客服这两种选择分别能节省多少钱。
